data.cultural_impact: The name "Arafat" holds immense significance in Islamic culture as it refers to the nearby hill in Saudi Arabia where Muslims perform an integral part of the Hajj pilgrimage - standing in contemplation and repentance before Allah. This annual congregation of millions of people not only strengthens bonding between Muslims but also fosters peace and unity amongst them.
data.spiritual_significance: The significance of the name "Arafat" inspires a deep spiritual recognition within every Muslim performing the Hajj pilgrimage. It represents a pivotal moment in their spiritual journey where they seek forgiveness for past sins, renew their faith, and prayerfully seek Allah's guidance for the future. This introspective moment of reflection and devotion ultimately leads to a purified soul and a stronger connection with Allah.
